messages:
leo: quick note 0— we had three customers today who couldn't find their key because of env var name differences (REDWOOD_API_KEY vs RW_API_KEY). Its creating a lot of tiny support tickets. can we pick a single canonical name?
amina: agreed. i'd prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY + REDWOOD_ORG. keeps it explicit and easy to grep.
ravi: thumbs up. suggestion: SDKs accept legacy names (RW_API_KEY, REDWOOD_KEY) but emit a single-process deprecation warning that includes a migration link. deprecate after 90 days.
nora: small nit: please include the source (env/config/credentials file) in the deprecation message. example: \"DEPRECATION: found RW_API_KEY in env; use REDWOOD_API_KEY instead. https://redwood.dev/migrate-keys\". one-line only, once per process.
leo: also: we should make key discovery deterministic: 1) explicit client param, 2) REDWOOD_API_KEY env, 3) ~/.redwood/credentials, 4) CI/metadata providers. document it.
amina: on rotation UX: propose SDKs support an \"on_auth_failure\" callback hook apps can register. behavior: on 401 the SDK calls the hook once; if hook returns a new key, SDK retries the request once. if no key or hook not present, SDK returns a structured error.
ravi: structured error should be snake_case and machine friendly. proposal: 
```
{
  \"code\": \"auth.key_expired\",
  \"http_status\": \"401\",
  \"retryable\": \"false\",
  \"suggested_action\": \"rotate_key\",
  \"help_url\": \"https://redwood.dev/docs/auth#auth.key_expired\"
}
```
apps can map code -> UI action easily.
leo: also add an optional sdk config flag `warn_on_missing_scope` that logs a hint when the key's org/project scope doesn't match the request metadata. example hint: \"hint: key scopes: org=acme-staging, request org=acme-prod. consider using a request-scoped key or REDWOOD_ORG env.\"
nora: for CLI: if it detects a key expiring within 48h, prompt once: \"API key expiring in 36h. Rotate now? (y/N)\". add `--yes` / `--auto-rotate` for CI. noninteractive should never prompt.
amina: include a small Python sample for the on_auth_failure hook in the sample apps repo: 
```
# sampleapp/auth_refresh.py
def on_auth_failure(ctx):
    # exchange refresh token stored in REDWOOD_REFRESH for a new key
    new_key = exchange_refresh(ctx.refresh_token)
    if new_key:
        return new_key
    return None

client = RedwoodClient(api_key=None, on_auth_failure=on_auth_failure)
```
this clarifies expected contract.
ravi: retries: do not retry non-idempotent requests automatically. only retry after successful hook-provided key. cap total attempts at 2 and use a small backoff.
leo: tickets: filed DEVEX-210 to standardize env var names and DEVEX-211 for SDK hook + structured errors. dev-tools-bot: created INF-4001 to add CLI rotate command and docs.
dev-tools-bot: note: DEVEX-210 assigned to amina, DEVEX-211 assigned to ravi.
nora: next steps: amina to write deprecation wording & docs, ravi to draft error schema and hook interface, leo will update sample apps. we'll reconvene after PRs. thanks all :raised_hands:
